task.title: L8b.1: copy registration of a non-manifest GGUF with a disk-space gate
task.objective: Phase L L8b.1 (awkit-djnl.12). E7 supersedes the manifest-only rule: a GGUF the manifest does not list is copied with the existing single hashed pass, stored under its SHA-256 and registered with its size and display-only file name. It is never curated and never loaded (MODEL_UNCHECKED) until the L8b.2 static and L8b.3 probe stages exist. Every import needs free space for the file plus 256 MB, measured at copy time and failing closed; preflight() reports the numbers without copying (its UI is L8b.5). The registry gains one optional field so old registries load unchanged, and a forged one reads unreadable. Tamper, swap, deletion, symlinked-source and path protections are re-proved for a registered model. No new channel or permission; no host change.

security: No new permission or channel: import stays ai:importModelPack under AI_MANAGE with re-authentication, and the renderer never supplies a path.
A registered model is never loaded before its compatibility stages exist; the host's path confinement is unchanged.
offline: Nothing is downloaded; the model is copied into the app-managed models folder, never into resources or app.asar.

acceptance.description: A non-manifest GGUF is copied, hashed and registered (never curated or loaded); the space gate and preflight hold; old registries load unchanged and forged ones read unreadable; tamper, swap, deletion and symlinked-source protections hold; each guarantee mutation-tested.
A registered-unchecked model never reaches the host; the backend pack and the Settings panels still pass.
Typecheck, bundles, script typecheck and the verifier registry pass.

completion.qc_basis: Independent QC 2026-09-30 (awkit-djnl.16, contract awkit-djnl-16-l8b-qc-0930): GPT-5.6 Luna through CodeCraft reviewed the copy import. It hashes exactly the bytes written, re-measures free space and registers an unlisted model with no checks or acknowledgement; verdicts and acknowledgements are gated on the active checksum. Checked against source by Claude. No product defect. A source file that grows mid-copy only fails the copy (LOW, kept).
